title: 23-Inch Three Tier Hotel-Style Towel Shelf With Drying Rack (Solid Brass) | Venetian Bronze | Towel Shelves | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep folded towels organized and give damp linens a dedicated place to dry—without taking up counter space in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. This three tier hotel-style towel shelf combines storage and a drying rack for efficient bathroom organization.

  • Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Built for lasting bathroom use: solid brass construction.
  • Easy to coordinate: designed to match the Towel Shelves towel shelves collection and complements transitional bathroom hardware.
  • Versatile placement: a smart choice for versatile bath accessories in guest baths and primary baths.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions: 23 in (L) x 10 in (H) x 9 in (W)
  • Shipping weight: 7 lbs
  • Installation: wall-mounted; mounting hardware included
  • Assembly: some assembly required
  • Assembled in the USA
